title: Deep learning-based computed tomography (CT) derived body composition classifier for colorectal cancer patients
abstract: arXiv:2608.15712v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Accurate body composition analysis using Computed Tomography (CT) scans is essential for assessing skeletal muscle area (SMA) and skeletal muscle density (SMD), key markers of nutritional status in cancer patients. Conventional manual methods are labour-intensive and require specialist expertise, limiting their routine clinical use. Therefore, this study serves as a feasibility and pilot investigation to explore the potential of deep learning-based automated regression for body composition analysis within a clinical workflow.   Methods: Four deep learning architectures (AlexNet, UNet, GoogLeNet, and ResNet34) were trained to predict SMA, SMD, subcutaneous fat area (SFA), and visceral fat area (VFA) from CT scans of colorectal cancer patients. translated_title: 基于深度学习的结直肠癌患者CT身体成分分类器
translated_abstract: 摘要：背景：使用计算机断层扫描（CT）进行准确的身体成分分析对于评估骨骼肌面积（SMA）和骨骼肌密度（SMD）至关重要，这些是癌症患者营养状况的关键标志。传统的手动方法劳动密集且需要专业知识，限制了其常规临床应用。因此，本研究作为一项可行性和试点调查，旨在探索基于深度学习的自动回归在临床工作流程中进行身体成分分析的潜力。方法：训练了四种深度学习架构（AlexNet、UNet、GoogLeNet和ResNet34），以从结直肠癌患者的CT扫描中预测SMA、SMD、皮下脂肪面积（SFA）和内脏脂肪面积（VFA）。系统性的超参数优化确定了最准确的模型，随后将其部署在临床使用的网络应用中。结果：GoogLeNet取得了最佳性能。
tldr: 本研究首次探索了多种深度学习模型在结直肠癌患者CT身体成分自动分析中的可行性，其中GoogLeNet表现最优，并成功将其整合到临床网络应用中，有望替代传统手动方法。
en_tdlr: This study pioneers the feasibility of multiple deep learning models for automated CT-based body composition analysis in colorectal cancer patients, with GoogLeNet achieving the best performance and successful integration into a clinical web application, potentially replacing conventional manual methods.
